note: Public claims that AGI has already been achieved, and how each claim fares under the main definitions. Predictions of future AGI are excluded.

definitions.strict: This site's strict bar: at least 80% of remote professional tasks, including multi-week projects, done reliably.
definitions.levels: DeepMind's "Levels of AGI": general "Competent" (50th percentile of skilled adults) across most tasks.
definitions.charter: OpenAI charter: highly autonomous systems that outperform humans at most economically valuable work.
definitions.v2: Definitions v2.0 (agi.html): full human cognitive autonomy; all eight parts met at once; physical work out of scope.

claims.narrowDef: Fridman's bar, which Huang accepted: an AI that could start, grow and run a tech company worth over $1B.
claims.interest: Sells the chips that AI is trained on.

claims.role: Physicist and arms-control analyst; says he coined the term "AGI"
